definitions.explanation: a figure from the Tanabata legend who represents the star Vega, separated from her lover Hikoboshi (Altair) by the Milky Way and allowed to meet him only once a year on the seventh of July

definitions.gloss: weaver woman; woman who weaves cloth
definitions.explanation: a woman whose occupation is weaving fabric on a loom

examples.japanese: {織姫|おりひめ}と{彦星|ひこぼし}の{伝説|でんせつ}は{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: The legend of Orihime and Hikoboshi is famous.

examples.japanese: {七夕|たなばた}の{夜|よる}に{織姫|おりひめ}と{彦星|ひこぼし}が{会|あ}える。
examples.english: On the night of Tanabata, Orihime and Hikoboshi can meet.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちは{七夕|たなばた}の{日|ひ}に、{織姫|おりひめ}と{彦星|ひこぼし}の{物語|ものがたり}を{聞|き}きながら{短冊|たんざく}に{願|ねが}いごとを{書|か}いた。
examples.english: On Tanabata, the children wrote their wishes on paper strips while listening to the story of Orihime and Hikoboshi.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}は{織姫|おりひめ}が{布|ぬの}を{織|お}っていた。
examples.english: In the old days, weaver women used to weave cloth.

examples.japanese: {村|むら}の{織姫|おりひめ}たちが{美|うつく}しい{反物|たんもの}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: The village weaver women made beautiful bolts of cloth.

examples.japanese: {機織|はたお}りの{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{受|う}け{継|つ}いだ{織姫|おりひめ}は、{地域|ちいき}の{伝統|でんとう}{工芸|こうげい}を{支|ささ}えていた。
examples.english: Weaver women who inherited the craft of weaving supported the region's traditional arts.

notes:
Written with {織|おり} (weaving) and {姫|ひめ} (princess, young woman). In its primary sense, {織姫|おりひめ} refers to the celestial weaver from the {七夕|たなばた} (Tanabata) festival legend, based on the Chinese tale of the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl. The star Vega in the constellation Lyra represents {織姫|おりひめ}, while Altair represents {彦星|ひこぼし}.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {七夕|たなばた} festival on July 7th celebrates this story. People write wishes on {短冊|たんざく} (paper strips) and hang them on bamboo branches, hoping for clear skies so the lovers can cross the {天|あま}の{川|がわ} (Milky Way) to reunite.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {彦星|ひこぼし}: Hikoboshi; the Cowherd Star (Altair) — {織姫|おりひめ}'s lover in the legend
- {七夕|たなばた}: Tanabata; Star Festival — the festival celebrating their reunion
- {機織|はたお}り: weaving — the act of weaving on a loom
